I’ve given them to athletes with their name & jersey number, to first time mommies with photos of them holding their babies, and many others with someone’s favorite color and name, design, or theme. Stanley must spending tons of money on marketing to get the brand to what it is now, but the customer service, and poor website design is so cheap and does not match the premium price.

Good luck Stanley.
